test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

Listening to the same lecture everyday appeared very _________ to him. (boring)
solution:
The correct answer is '**monotonous**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**monotonous**" means dull, tedious, and repetitious; lacking in variety and interest. (एकसार)
 
• Listening to the same lecture every day can make the experience feel very repetitive and uninteresting.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Listening to the same lecture every day appeared very monotonous__ to him.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Furious (उग्र)**: means extremely angry.
 
• **Nervous (चिंतित)**: means easily agitated or alarmed; tending to be anxious.
 
• **Monolithic (एकाश्म)**: means large, powerful, and intractably indivisible and uniform.
